facts.fact: The Daily News reports that the Tanzania Revenue Authority's Integrated Domestic Revenue Administration System (IDRAS) began operation in January 2025, with a first phase of vehicle registration and driver's licence systems launched in February 2025.

The Tanzania Revenue Authority's Integrated Domestic Revenue Administration System (IDRAS) was scheduled to launch on 9 February 2026, replacing separate VAT and other platforms with one system handling registration, return filing, payments, objections and sales monitoring, per the Commissioner for Domestic Revenue.
The government told the World Bank's GovTech survey (2025 round) that e-filing for tax and/or customs declarations is available and in use in Tanzania; the round's year stands for as_of.
